Name: Cacti Hurt You
Author: CatCattyCat
Description:
[size=6]Cacti Hurt You
[img]https://i.imgur.com/MI23tSv.gif[/img]
[size=3]Cacti in the desert and the ones you plant will hurt you a little bit when you either run into them or click on them. Ouch!
[/size][/size][size=3](You won't be hurt when harvesting cactus fruit from cacti, when the cacti plant is a seed, or when you water your cactus.)

[size=4]Requires SMAPI by Pathoschild.[/size][size=4]

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/44734342?tab=user+files][size=5]Check out my other mods by clicking here![/size][/url][/size][/size]

Downloads.Description: Place in your Stardew Valley/Mods folder to install.

Manifest.Name: Cacti Hurt You
Manifest.Description: Touching cacti will hurt you. Ouch!
